command: set -euo pipefail; root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omegacv1-tree.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$root"' EXIT; echo ROOT=$root; git clone --quiet https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/oMEGAcV1.git "$root/repo"; cd "$root/repo"; echo REPO_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); bash scripts/validate-research-surface.sh; mkdir -p "$root/toolchain"; ver=1.27.1; curl -fsSL 'https://go.dev/dl/?mode=json&include=all' -o "$root/go.json"; sha=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('$root/go.json')); print(next(f['sha256'] for r in d if r['version']=='go$ver' for f in r['files'] if f['filename']=='go$ver.linux-amd64.tar.gz'))"); curl -fsSL "https://go.dev/dl/go$ver.linux-amd64.tar.gz" -o "$root/go.tgz"; echo "$sha  $root/go.tgz" | sha256sum -c -; tar -C "$root/toolchain" -xzf "$root/go.tgz"; export PATH="$root/toolchain/go/bin:$PATH"; bash scripts/materialize-harness.sh "$root/materialized"; cd "$root/materialized"; go test ./...; go build -trimpath -o "$root/omegacv1" .; sha256sum "$root/omegacv1"; echo MODES; git -C "$root/repo" ls-files -s scripts/materialize-harness.sh scripts/build-release.sh scripts/validate-research-surface.sh dist/omegacv1-current-source.sh;
